integrity: All statements in the finding follow from its own complete analytic proof. Numerical evidence is supplementary, not an infinite-dimensional certificate. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem does not classify infinite-dimensional nonattaining extremal spaces; historical equivalences under unrelated terminology remain a priority risk. Only abstract-level access to two earlier journal papers was available.
title: The sharp \(\sqrt{2}\) ceiling for Birkhoff-restricted angular distortion
